links.outcome: Effect of LLM clarification questions on note completeness and ICD-10 coding performance
links.effect: Useful questions depend on the task, but about 9% of clarification turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite.
links.quote: About 9% of turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite.

unlisted_practices: LLM-driven automated provider query loop (Draft, Ask, Update) to close documentation gaps in ambient transcripts
Auditing real visits to identify sources of missing documentation in ambient transcripts
Training the model to learn when not to ask clarifying questions

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating an automated query-loop safeguard/workflow (Draft, Ask, Update) using LLMs to detect gaps in ambient clinical documentation and generate clarifying requests to providers, analyzing performance impacts and failure modes (e.g., redundant questions hurt performance).
